title: Podcast flow diagram template
subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 54 (Podcast flow diagram template)
intro: Lesson 54: Planning a podcast episode in segments with a flow diagram. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

parts.text: Intro (Amina): welcome, today's question: what will school be like in 2050?
Segment 1 (Bilal): three gadgets that might help us learn
Transition: "Gadgets are great, but are they safe? Sara?"
Conclusion (Amina): summary and a question for listeners

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A timed flow diagram with transitions

keywords.def: boxes and arrows showing the order of steps
a line that moves from one segment to the next

questions.q: Write a transition from robots to online safety
questions.a: For example: Robots sound amazing, but how do we stay safe with all this technology? Sara has some tips.

questions.q: Write an opening question for your episode
questions.a: For example: What will school be like in 2050?
For example: Thanks for listening. See you next episode!

questions.q: Core: in a breakout group, complete the flow diagram: segments, who speaks, timings and transition lines
Extend: write bullet notes (not a full script) for your own segment
Stretch: plan one question each to ask another group member during the episode

options: So that is robots. But could a robot ever be your teacher? Over to Bilal.
questions.a: B) So that is robots. But could a robot ever be your teacher? Over to Bilal.. B links the two segments with a question and hands over clearly.
